description: NaZnAsO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.74 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four ZnO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six AsO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ZnO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.66 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-3.08 Å. There are three inequivalent Zn²⁺ sites. In the first Zn²⁺ site, Zn²⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 67°. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-1.96 Å. In the second Zn²⁺ site, Zn²⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 67°. There are three shorter (1.95 Å) and one longer (1.96 Å) Zn-O bond length. In the third Zn²⁺ site, Zn²⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 64-71°. There are three shorter (1.94 Å) and one longer (1.96 Å) Zn-O bond length. There are three inequivalent As⁵⁺ sites. In the first As⁵⁺ site, As⁵⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four ZnO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-51°. All As-O bond lengths are 1.70 Å. In the second As⁵⁺ site, As⁵⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four ZnO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-69°. There is one shorter (1.69 Å) and three longer (1.70 Å) As-O bond lengths. In the third As⁵⁺ site, As⁵⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four ZnO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-65°. All As-O bond lengths are 1.70 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the fourth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the fifth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the sixth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the seventh O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the eighth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the ninth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the tenth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the eleventh O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom. In the twelfth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na¹⁺, one Zn²⁺, and one As⁵⁺ atom.
